entities.name: GNSS synchronization reference source
entities.description: GNSS selected as the synchronization reference source for NR sidelink communication/discovery. Provides UTC time for DFN derivation.

entities.name: DFN derivation from GNSS
entities.description: Procedure to derive DFN, subframe number, and slot number from GNSS UTC time using specified formulae.

entities.name: Current UTC time
entities.description: Current UTC time obtained from GNSS, expressed in milliseconds as Tcurrent.

entities.name: Reference UTC time
entities.description: Reference UTC time 00:00:00 on 1 January 1900, expressed in milliseconds as Tref.

entities.name: DFN offset
entities.description: Offset value for DFN derivation, set to sl-OffsetDFN if configured, otherwise zero. Expressed in milliseconds.

entities.name: SCS index
entities.description: Index value (0/1/2/3) corresponding to 15/30/60/120 kHz subcarrier spacing for sidelink.

entities.name: Leap second change condition
entities.description: Condition where leap second change events occur, requiring UE implementation to handle UTC time adjustment and avoid DFN discontinuity.

relations.description: DFN derivation procedure requires GNSS to be selected as synchronization reference source.
DFN derivation procedure uses current UTC time (Tcurrent) from GNSS as input.
DFN derivation procedure uses reference UTC time (Tref) as baseline for calculations.
DFN derivation procedure applies DFN offset value in the calculation.
DFN derivation procedure uses SCS index to determine subcarrier spacing for sidelink.
Leap second change condition affects how current UTC time is obtained and adjusted.
